name: UltraChat
description: A dataset of about 1.5 million multi-turn instruction dialogues. Related dialogue datasets include OpenAssistant OASST and LMSYS-Chat-1M. UltraChat is non-commercial; no data is vendored.
citation: UltraChat: A Large-Scale Auto-Augmented Conversation Dataset for Instruction Following. Ding et al., 2023.
